purpose: Build reviewed source-memory/current-problem dossiers before worker utility measurement; discovery only
repository_selection: Purposive first batch: Python filesystem/serialization/output/tooling libraries with multiple distinct problems in the existing identifier-only row-group inventory. No external service, large-model or GPU requirement is intended. This is not a population-random benchmark.
prior_overlap_check: Case-insensitive repository and owner__repo identifiers in tracked JSON/JSONL/CSV under datasets, docs/design-data, training/memory_selector/reviews, plus the previous 30-repository trajectory intake. Exclude any match. This checks the named local inventories, not all possible historic exposure.
source_target_assignment: After joining task metadata, order distinct issues by PR created_at then instance_id; take the earliest two as source candidates and the latest as the current target, using the first trajectory occurrence for each issue. Require at least three issues. PR creation order is only an initial filter, not proof that an experience was available at target time.
source_memory_freeze: Inspect and draft source-only cards before opening target problem bodies. Hash that draft; subsequent target-conditioned changes require an explicit amended version and cannot be confirmatory.
target_visibility: Export target task metadata/problem statement only. Do not export target trajectory, future commands, patches, generated tests, official tests or outcome columns. PyArrow may decode a column batch containing target rows; those messages are not presented to the reviewer or saved.
inspection: Next, obtain only the target base-commit files needed to check the proposed premise. Record exact file hashes and revision. This researcher inspection is not the future fixed worker's common inspection or a fully restorable worker snapshot.
retention: Keep the full intake ledger and all exclusion/unresolved decisions. Do not select on worker success, model predictions or expected positive treatment effect. Do not force an applicable memory for every target.
split: All records in this batch are discovery-only. Sources, targets, reconstructed variants and future rollouts retain repository/issue parent IDs. A later confirmation set must be separately selected.
relation_review: Single-agent provisional review; no independent agreement claim. Applicability is not provide/withhold, and a repaired source command is not whole-task success.
